run_main_fine_tune: run the SNN fine-tuning training loop with distributed data parallel support on a dataset
load_pretrained_encoder: load a pretrained encoder model from a checkpoint file into the current model
load_from_path_checkpoint: load encoder, optimizer, scheduler, and scaler state from a saved checkpoint file
init_model_encoder: initialize a ResNet or WideResNet encoder with projection head, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
use_nostdout_context: use the nostdout context manager to temporarily suppress stdout and logging output
